name: @avatark/runtime-contracts
description: Type-only contracts for the Runtime Kernel (Runtime, Repository, Adapter, Snapshot, Reference, Transition, Event, Progress, Checkpoint, State, History, Resolver, Host, Lifecycle, Version) -- no implementations, no storage, no React, no Supabase, zero dependencies.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json --outDir dist --declaration --noEmit false --rewriteRelativeImportExtensions --module esnext --moduleResolution bundler && node ../../scripts/fix-dts-extensions.mjs dist
